novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3 / Assumption ass:local-spectral-trichotomy
novelty_flags.one_line: The advertised uniform rank adaptation is obtained only after excluding the unresolved singular-value threshold band by a growing spectral gap, so it is not yet an inference advance over the standard weak-identification continuum.

novelty_flags.label: Related work for Theorems 2–3
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey misses closer generic comparators—HongLi2018 numerical delta method and AndrewsChengGuggenberger2020 generic uniform size results—which must be distinguished from the proposed discontinuous gain setting.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 / power_G_n
soundness_flags.one_line: The Gaussian rejection probability is only described in prose and does not define its Gaussian analogue of the selected critical-value rule, so the displayed approximation to pi_n^G is not evaluable.

soundness_flags.label: Assumption ass:uniform-multiplier-approximation
soundness_flags.one_line: FangSantos2019 studies a known directionally differentiable map and its derivative-aware resampling scheme, not the asserted generic uniform conditional multiplier Gaussian approximation for an unspecified cross-fitted draw.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Application-specific reduced-form estimator
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform asymptotic linearity, covariance consistency, and a valid multiplier approximation for the actual DDD reduced-form estimator are assumed application-level inputs, not derived by this generic result.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline is conditional on a declared retained-score application verifying these three inputs for its regular factor chart.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Imported DDD bridge
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The retained-score chart, shared-cell covariance construction, and Schur variance-gap identity are imported from stat_ddd_overid_efficiency/v1.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Novelty is limited to weak-rank gain behavior and inference conditional on that imported finite-dimensional bridge.

source_verification_receipts.version: Review of Economic Studies 86(1), 2019 version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper considers inference for phi(theta_0) with phi a known directionally differentiable map and proposes an alternative resampling method with local size control under restrictions on its directional derivative.
The paper studies weak, semi-strong, and strong identification over drifting sequences and establishes uniform asymptotic size for tests and confidence sets in its extremum-estimation framework.
The paper formulates semiparametric weak identification through weakly regular parameters and underlying regular parameters, with applications to linear IV and nonlinear regression.
The paper develops inference for the rank of an unknown matrix, including nonstandard rank-boundary limits and bootstrap critical values.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the spectral trichotomy by a local class that includes the threshold band, or explicitly narrow the headline to separated strata and make threshold-band attainability the open-ended question.
Define pi_n^G as an explicit known-V Gaussian implementation of every branch of the test, including its projection, localized direction set, and critical-value selection.

Specify the multiplier draw from estimated influence functions and cite a result that actually supplies the needed uniform conditional approximation; add Hong–Li and Andrews–Cheng–Guggenberger to the comparison table.
